regions.body: Entry before input loads through the selected post-output-store barrier, on each executing actor where endpoints exist.
regions.output: Entry to downstream output processing through the selected barrier after its global store; includes readiness wait and input/workspace transfer executed within that region.

constraints: Local brackets do not establish unperturbed engine busy time.
Do not subtract actor clocks without a verified relation.
Separate replay captures share a logical request but not a physical invocation.
Report unavailable boundaries explicitly; do not replace missing observations with inferred timing.
Control-path projections do not promise minimum entry/maximum exit across every execution lane.

recording_actors.cuda: thread0 control-path projection of each logical CTA/program; selected post-store group barrier
recording_actors.enflame: work-item0 control-path projection of each logical program; selected post-store group barrier
recording_actors.cann: logical block + AIC/AIV + subblock scalar control path; selected PIPE_ALL endpoints
